title: Business Formation & Compliance
description: Getting the structure and the agreements right at the start prevents most partnership disputes later. We also handle licensing, violations and trademarks.
intro: In nearly every partnership dispute we see, the root cause traces back to the opening weeks: no operating agreement, no record of who contributed what, no exit mechanism. Time spent at formation is usually the best-value investment a new business makes. (This is general information about how such matters usually proceed, not advice on your specific case. Where representation is needed, a licensed attorney at a partner law firm handles it.)
